live_dispatch.scope: Fresh isolated CLI session; fixed-text response prompt; no tools requested
live_dispatch.inference: This installed IDE's current provider is not available to the cold CLI invocation; IDE login must not be represented as verified CLI login.

capability_evidence.model: Run accepts provider/model; the adapter validates explicit IDs against the official models catalog and never substitutes a different model.
capability_evidence.default_model: Omitted to retain native configuration; no default model was guessed.
capability_evidence.stream: Installed CLI source emits text JSON events only after text part time.end. Token streaming is disabled on this transport.
capability_evidence.thinking: --thinking displays completed reasoning blocks; it is not a reasoning enable/disable control. Both explicit on and off are rejected.
capability_evidence.images: Installed CLI source labels all ordinary --file attachments text/plain. Images are rejected.
capability_evidence.text_files: The CLI accepts file attachments. Adapter validates UTF-8 text only. Successful provider reading is unverified while authentication/provider is blocked.
capability_evidence.pure: Official help says run without external plugins. This does not establish that every MCP integration is disabled. AGENTHUB_WORKER_ID=codearts additionally identifies the worker to the native integration's recursion guard.

regressions.note: Fixture and process-boundary regressions, not successful live-provider task evidence.
